title: Semantic Candidate-Job Matching: A Comparative Evaluation of Dense Embedding Models in Hybrid Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2609.23307v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents a comparative evaluation of dense embedding models for semantic candidate-job matching in high-volume staffing workflows. Incoming job descriptions are converted into structured English search text and language-specific keywords through LLM-based parsing, and candidate profiles are indexed as semantically enriched resume representations. We evaluate EmbeddingGemma (base) against EmbeddingGemma fine-tuned with Cached Multiple Negatives Ranking Loss (MNRL) within a unified hybrid retrieval pipeline that fuses vector similarity and full-text relevance via reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), and benchmark both against the MPNet model on a batch comparative evaluation dataset scored through the deployed job-candidate matching scoring pipeline. translated_title: 语义化候选人-职位匹配：混合检索中稠密嵌入模型的对比评估
translated_abstract: 本文对高流量人力资源招聘工作流中用于语义化候选人-职位匹配的稠密嵌入模型进行了对比评估。输入的职位描述通过基于大语言模型（LLM）的解析被转换为结构化的英文检索文本和特定语言的关键词，候选人档案则以语义增强的简历表示形式进行索引。我们在一个统一的混合检索流水线中评估了 EmbeddingGemma（基础版）与使用缓存多负例排序损失（Cached Multiple Negatives Ranking Loss, MNRL）微调后的 EmbeddingGemma，该流水线通过倒数排序融合（RRF）将向量相似度与全文相关性进行融合；并在批量对比评估数据集上，通过已部署的职位-候选人匹配打分流水线进行评分，将上述两个模型与 MPNet 模型进行基准对比。此外，我们进一步以数学细节完整记录了模型开发过程中所考虑的更广泛的对比微调目标集合（包括 AnglE/CoSENT 风格的改进方法）以及……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文在高流量招聘场景的混合检索流水线中，通过倒数排序融合向量相似度与全文相关性，对比评估了基础版与MNRL微调版的EmbeddingGemma以及MPNet在候选人-职位语义匹配任务上的表现，并详细记录了所探索的多种对比微调目标。
en_tdlr: This paper comparatively evaluates dense embedding models—base EmbeddingGemma, EmbeddingGemma fine-tuned with Cached MNRL, and MPNet—for semantic candidate-job matching within a unified hybrid retrieval pipeline that fuses vector similarity and full-text relevance via reciprocal rank fusion, while also documenting the broader set of contrastive fine-tuning objectives explored during model development.
